"""
Generate a professional 1200x630 promotional banner for Zeus Tech Repairs.
Bulgarian text advertising fast diagnostics and discount deals.
Shows yesterday's 4 PM Sofia temperature (18.9°C) in the top corner.
"""
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

# --- Configuration ---
WIDTH, HEIGHT = 1200, 630
TEMP_TEXT = "18.9°C"
OUTPUT = "sofia_promo_banner.png"

# Colors
BG_DARK = (10, 22, 40)
BG_MID = (18, 35, 65)
ACCENT = (0, 212, 255)
ACCENT_DIM = (0, 140, 190)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (200, 210, 225)
BADGE_BG = (0, 180, 240)

# --- Font loading (Windows system fonts with Cyrillic support) ---
def load_font(size, bold=False):
    candidates = []
    if bold:
        candidates = [
            "C:/Windows/Fonts/arialbd.ttf",
            "C:/Windows/Fonts/segoeuib.ttf",
            "C:/Windows/Fonts/calibrib.ttf",
        ]
    else:
        candidates = [
            "C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf",
            "C:/Windows/Fonts/segoeui.ttf",
            "C:/Windows/Fonts/calibri.ttf",
        ]
    for path in candidates:
        if os.path.exists(path):
            return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    return ImageFont.load_default()

font_brand = load_font(72, bold=True)
font_headline = load_font(52, bold=True)
font_sub = load_font(36)
font_temp = load_font(28, bold=True)
font_small = load_font(24)

# --- Create base image with vertical gradient ---
img = Image.new("RGB", (WIDTH, HEIGHT), BG_DARK)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Draw gradient background
for y in range(HEIGHT):
    ratio = y / HEIGHT
    r = int(BG_DARK[0] + (BG_MID[0] - BG_DARK[0]) * ratio)
    g = int(BG_DARK[1] + (BG_MID[1] - BG_DARK[1]) * ratio)
    b = int(BG_DARK[2] + (BG_MID[2] - BG_DARK[2]) * ratio)
    draw.line([(0, y), (WIDTH, y)], fill=(r, g, b))

# --- Decorative elements ---
# Subtle diagonal accent (top-left)
draw.polygon([(0, 0), (400, 0), (0, 200)], fill=(0, 50, 80))
# Bottom-right accent
draw.polygon([(WIDTH, HEIGHT), (WIDTH, HEIGHT - 150), (WIDTH - 300, HEIGHT)], fill=(0, 40, 70))

# Thin accent bar on the left
draw.rectangle([(0, 0), (6, HEIGHT)], fill=ACCENT)

# --- Temperature Badge (top-right corner) ---
badge_x = WIDTH - 200
badge_y = 25
badge_w = 170
badge_h = 50
# Rounded rectangle for badge
badge = Image.new("RGBA", (badge_w, badge_h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
badge_draw = ImageDraw.Draw(badge)
badge_draw.rounded_rectangle([(0, 0), (badge_w - 1, badge_h - 1)], radius=12, fill=BADGE_BG)
img.paste(badge, (badge_x, badge_y), badge)

# Small label above badge
draw.text((badge_x, badge_y - 24), "СЪРБИЯ • ВЧЕРА 16:00", font=font_small, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
# Temperature text on badge
draw.text((badge_x + 15, badge_y + 10), TEMP_TEXT, font=font_temp, fill=WHITE)

# --- Main Content ---
# Brand name
draw.text((60, 80), "ZEUS", font=font_brand, fill=ACCENT)
draw.text((310, 80), "TECH REPAIRS", font=font_brand, fill=WHITE)

# Separator line
sep_y = 175
draw.line([(60, sep_y), (700, sep_y)], fill=ACCENT_DIM, width=2)

# Headline (Bulgarian)
draw.text((60, 210), "БЪРЗА ДИАГНОСТИКА", font=font_headline, fill=WHITE)

# Sub-headline
draw.text((60, 290), "и отлични промоционални оферти", font=font_sub, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)

# Bullet points / features
features = [
    "✓  Диагностика за под 30 минути",
    "✓  До 30% отстъпка за всички услуги",
    "✓  Гаранция на всички ремонти",
]
feature_y = 370
for feat in features:
    draw.text((80, feature_y), feat, font=font_sub, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    feature_y += 50

# --- CTA Button (bottom area) ---
cta_x = 60
cta_y = HEIGHT - 100
cta_w = 320
cta_h = 55
cta = Image.new("RGBA", (cta_w, cta_h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
cta_draw = ImageDraw.Draw(cta)
cta_draw.rounded_rectangle([(0, 0), (cta_w - 1, cta_h - 1)], radius=10, fill=ACCENT)
img.paste(cta, (cta_x, cta_y), cta)
draw.text((cta_x + 20, cta_y + 12), "СВЪРЖЕТЕ СЕ ДНЕС", font=font_small, fill=BG_DARK)

# --- Footer text ---
draw.text((WIDTH - 350, HEIGHT - 35), "sofia • zeustech.com", font=font_small, fill=ACCENT_DIM)

# --- Save ---
img.save(OUTPUT, "PNG", optimize=True)
print(f"Banner saved: {OUTPUT}")
print(f"Size: {img.size}")
print(f"Temp shown: {TEMP_TEXT}")

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

# --- Configuration ---
WIDTH, HEIGHT = 1200, 630
BG_TOP = (10, 22, 40)       # #0a1628
BG_BOTTOM = (26, 42, 74)    # #1a2a4a
GOLD = (240, 192, 64)       # #f0c040
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_BLUE = (176, 196, 222)  # #b0c4de
TEMP = "33.6°C"

# --- Create gradient background ---
img = Image.new("RGB", (WIDTH, HEIGHT))
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

for y in range(HEIGHT):
    ratio = y / HEIGHT
    r = int(BG_TOP[0] + (BG_BOTTOM[0] - BG_TOP[0]) * ratio)
    g = int(BG_TOP[1] + (BG_BOTTOM[1] - BG_TOP[1]) * ratio)
    b = int(BG_TOP[2] + (BG_BOTTOM[2] - BG_TOP[2]) * ratio)
    draw.line([(0, y), (WIDTH, y)], fill=(r, g, b))

# --- Decorative elements ---
# Subtle diagonal accent line
draw.line([(0, HEIGHT - 80), (WIDTH, HEIGHT - 140)], fill=GOLD, width=2)

# Small lightning bolt icon (drawn as polygon) - top left area
bolt_points = [
    (60, 80), (75, 80), (68, 105), (80, 105),
    (55, 145), (63, 115), (50, 115), (60, 80)
]
draw.polygon(bolt_points, fill=GOLD)

# --- Try to load fonts (fallback to default) ---
def load_font(size, bold=False):
    paths = [
        "C:/Windows/Fonts/arialbd.ttf" if bold else "C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf",
        "C:/Windows/Fonts/segoeuib.ttf" if bold else "C:/Windows/Fonts/segoeui.ttf",
        "C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf",
    ]
    for p in paths:
        if os.path.exists(p):
            try:
                return ImageFont.truetype(p, size)
            except:
                pass
    return ImageFont.load_default()

font_brand = load_font(52, bold=True)
font_headline = load_font(48, bold=True)
font_sub = load_font(32)
font_cta = load_font(28, bold=True)
font_temp = load_font(36, bold=True)
font_temp_label = load_font(20)

# --- Brand name (top-left) ---
draw.text((40, 20), "ZEUS TECH REPAIRS", font=font_brand, fill=GOLD)

# --- Weather badge (top-right) ---
badge_text = f"{TEMP} | 22.08, 16:00"
badge_font = font_temp
tmp_bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), badge_text, font=badge_font)
badge_w = tmp_bbox[2] - tmp_bbox[0] + 40
badge_h = tmp_bbox[3] - tmp_bbox[1] + 24
badge_x = WIDTH - badge_w - 30
badge_y = 20

# Rounded rectangle badge
draw.rounded_rectangle(
    [badge_x, badge_y, badge_x + badge_w, badge_y + badge_h],
    radius=12, fill=GOLD
)
draw.text((badge_x + 20, badge_y + 8), badge_text, font=badge_font, fill=BG_TOP)

# --- Main headline (center) ---
headline = "БЪРЗА ДИАГНОСТИКА"
head_bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), headline, font=font_headline)
head_w = head_bbox[2] - head_bbox[0]
draw.text(((WIDTH - head_w) // 2, 200), headline, font=font_headline, fill=WHITE)

# --- Subheadline ---
sub = "Сезонни отстъпки до 20% за всички ремонти"
sub_bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), sub, font=font_sub)
sub_w = sub_bbox[2] - sub_bbox[0]
draw.text(((WIDTH - sub_w) // 2, 280), sub, font=font_sub, fill=LIGHT_BLUE)

# --- Feature bullets ---
features = [
    "\u2714 Бърза диагностика — до 30 минути",
    "\u2714 Честни цени, без скрити такси",
    "\u2714 Гаранция на всеки ремонт",
]
start_y = 360
for i, feat in enumerate(features):
    draw.text((120, start_y + i * 45), feat, font=font_sub, fill=WHITE)

# --- CTA button (bottom center) ---
cta_text = "ЗАПИШИ СЕ ЗА БЕЗПЛАТНА ДИАГНОСТИКА"
cta_bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), cta_text, font=font_cta)
cta_w = cta_bbox[2] - cta_bbox[0] + 50
cta_h = 55
cta_x = (WIDTH - cta_w) // 2
cta_y = HEIGHT - 100

draw.rounded_rectangle(
    [cta_x, cta_y, cta_x + cta_w, cta_y + cta_h],
    radius=10, fill=GOLD
)
draw.text((cta_x + 25, cta_y + 12), cta_text, font=font_cta, fill=BG_TOP)

# --- Footer ---
draw.text((40, HEIGHT - 40), "\U0001F4CD София  |  \U0001F4E1 DM за записка", font=font_temp_label, fill=LIGHT_BLUE)

# --- Save ---
output_path = "sofia_promo_banner.png"
img.save(output_path, "PNG")
print(f"Banner saved: {output_path} ({WIDTH}x{HEIGHT})")

"""
Customer Data Validator & Metrics Calculator
"""

from datetime import datetime

def validate_user_record(record):
    if not isinstance(record, dict):
        return False
    if "email" not in record or "@" not in record["email"]:
        return False
    if record.get("age", 0) < 18:
        return False
    return True

def parse_iso_date(date_str):
    """
    Parses 'YYYY-MM-DD' and returns (year, month, day).
    Buggy implementation: month is 0-indexed or day offset.
    """
    # BUG: using split with index error on day
    parts = date_str.strip().split("-")
    year = int(parts[0])
    month = int(parts[1])
    # The bug: subtracted 1 from day erroneously
    day = int(parts[2])
    return year, month, day

def calculate_discounted_total(items, discount_percent, tax_percent=0.0):
    """
    Calculates total cost after discount and tax.
    items: list of dicts with 'price' and 'qty'
    """
    subtotal = sum(item["price"] * item["qty"] for item in items)
    if subtotal <= 0:
        return 0.0

    # BUG: division by zero if discount_percent == 100 or wrong math
    effective_multiplier = (100 - discount_percent) / 100.0
    discounted = subtotal * effective_multiplier

    # Tax calculation
    tax_amount = discounted * (tax_percent / 100.0)
    return round(discounted + tax_amount, 2)

"""
Sample data validator for user records.
"""

def validate_user_record(record: dict) -> bool:
    """Validate a user record has required fields."""
    if "email" not in record or "age" not in record:
        return False
    # Check email format
    if "@" not in record["email"]:
        return False
    # Check age range
    if record["age"] < 18 or record["age"] > 120:
        return False
    return True

def parse_iso_date(date_str: str) -> tuple:
    """Parse an ISO date string into (year, month, day) tuple."""
    parts = date_str.split("-")
    year = int(parts[0])
    month = int(parts[1])
    day = int(parts[2])  # Fixed: removed off-by-one error (was subtracting 1)
    return (year, month, day)

def calculate_discounted_total(items: list, discount_pct: float, tax_pct: float) -> float:
    """Calculate the total after discount and tax."""
    subtotal = sum(item["price"] * item["qty"] for item in items)
    discount = subtotal * (discount_pct / 100.0)
    discounted = subtotal - discount
    tax = discounted * (tax_pct / 100.0)
    total = discounted + tax
    return round(total, 2)
